name: dutyboard
description: DutyBoard — a coordination bus, external working memory and human-in-the-loop decision engine for autonomous agents, built on altengine functions + datastore + auth + channel.

scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:app && npm run build:bundle
scripts.setup: npm run build:fn && cd cli && go run ./cmd/dutyboard --provision-only --local --source ..
scripts.deploy: npm run build:fn && cd cli && go run ./cmd/dutyboard --provision-only --source ..
